name: Hash generator
description: Create a SHA fingerprint of text or any file, to check that it has not changed.

seo.metaTitle: Hash generator — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Create a SHA fingerprint of text or any file, to check that it has not changed. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/crypto/hash-gen-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Hash generator processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/crypto/hash-gen-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Hash generator upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Hash generator executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/crypto/hash-gen-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Hash generator?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/hash_gen.json or open /tools/hash-gen?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
